info.name: Legal AI - Fullstack API Master (Admin + Customer)
info.description:
Complete Fullstack API Collection for Legal AI:
- [ADMIN] Port 5001 APIs: User administration, Masters, Security, Subscriptions, Inquiries, Audit logs
- [CUSTOMER] Port 5000 APIs: Auth, Research, Judgments, Documents, Contracts, Matters, Tasks, Calendar, Drafting
